caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing figure, dressed in a colorful costume and posed with the right arm bent at the elbow and the fist raised, while the left arm is bent in front of the chest. The figure has brown skin and short dark hair. On the head is an elaborate headdress with upright feathers in shades of blue, red, purple, and light yellow, with a golden-yellow element in the center of the forehead. The upper part of the costume consists of a blue long-sleeved shirt with light yellow trim and green accents. The figure wears a necklace of white beads. Draped over the shoulders and around the back is a yellow and green sash or mantle. The lower garment is a red skirt decorated with downward-pointing, white and gray feather shapes. The legs are exposed from mid-thigh down, ending in brown shoes. The figure stands on a rectangular gray base. The background is plain, cream-colored paper.
title: Cigar Store Indian
